candidates.name: git-fetch documentation
verified_facts: git fetch downloads remote objects and refs needed to complete their histories
Remote-tracking branches are updated according to the fetched refspec
semantic_limits: Fetch synchronizes repository objects and refs but does not start the external F-host daemon

candidates.name: git-reset documentation
verified_facts: git reset accepts a target tree-ish and can move repository state to that target
The guarded recovery script applies reset only after a clean-repository and remote-head readback gate
semantic_limits: A hard reset is destructive to local changes; the recovery script therefore blocks on any dirty repository state

candidates.name: Get-CimInstance
verified_facts: Get-CimInstance retrieves CIM instances and supports the Win32_Process class
The existing restart helper inspects Win32_Process command lines before deciding whether a canonical daemon already exists
semantic_limits: Repository validation can parse the script but cannot observe processes on the external F-host

candidates.name: Start-Process
verified_facts: Start-Process starts a process on the local computer and supports explicit executable, arguments and working directory
The existing helper uses Start-Process only after zero canonical processes are observed and then waits for the persistent daemon
semantic_limits: Start-Process documentation does not prove that the external operator invoked the recovery script
